column3: Inquiries take ~24h+ to post — same-day submission means each lender sees the pre-set file. Order within the day per 1B (e.g. EX Set 1: FNBO first — it is inquiry-sensitive and won't combine same-day pulls; Amex last/soft).
column4: This is the entire point of "sets of 3" (1B RULE row 11).

column1: SECTION 3 — BANKER CALL SCRIPT (ask all 7 on every call/visit — every call mints a verified DP for Tab 8)

column3: "Which personal credit bureau do you pull for business card/LOC applications — TransUnion, Experian, or Equifax?"
column4: Slots the institution into the right sprint (or out of it).

column3: "Is that a hard or soft pull? Do you offer any prequalification with a soft pull only?"
column4: Soft/pre-qual lanes (FNBO, PNC BLOC) are free looks — always take them first.

column3: "What documents are required at my revenue/time-in-business level — and at what limit does it become full-doc?"
column4: Defines whether the row stays in the no-doc plan and where the full-doc cliff is.

column3: "Is a personal guarantee required?"
column4: PG = personal liability + personal-bureau exposure on default; non-PG lanes are rare (Ramp/Mercury/Sam's EIN).

column3: "Do you use ChexSystems or Early Warning when opening the deposit account?"
column4: Decides where the account-opening fits in the Chex-clean window (1B pre-work).

column3: "What are typical starting limits for a business like mine, and what's the credit-line-increase policy and timeline?"
column4: A $5K start with 91-day soft CLIs can beat a $10K start with hard-pull CLIs (§5.5).

column3: "Does the card report to my personal credit — always, never, or only on default?"
column4: Drives the utilization rule (§5.4) and protects personal scores between sprints.
